scoring_policy: Apply only dimension-level changes backed by immutable source references. Code-only evidence cannot satisfy a live-required condition.

entries.summary: The operating system now separates immutable business snapshots from external publication receipts and invalidates stale receipt evidence automatically when the snapshot changes.
entries.next_quality_threshold: Expand source-linked evidence collection into provider, live and observed business-outcome connectors.

entries.summary: Adaptive intelligence now has a canonical source-observation layer that can represent merged changes, workflow results, exact live proof, observed outcomes and owner confirmations before they influence strategic percentages. This improves evidence adaptability but does not claim that provider, live or business KPI collectors already exist.
entries.next_quality_threshold: Connect the proof-gated observation layer to current provider readiness, public receipts, observed conversion and retry-cost collectors.

entries.summary: Source-linked dimension updates, anti-inflation ceilings, live-proof gates, duplicate protection and five regression cases are now merged and mandatory in both strategic publication and Agent Harness validation.
entries.next_quality_threshold: Connect the validated evidence ledger to provider, public-live, conversion and retry-cost sources.

entries.summary: The portfolio operating system now has a trigger-independent, receipt-aware recovery contract that preserves validation diagnostics, exact-snapshot ownership and one-publisher architecture while retrying stale publication safely.
entries.next_quality_threshold: Connect recovery outcomes and public receipts to the strategic evidence ledger automatically.

entries.summary: The snapshot-bound publication receipt loop, repository-dispatch listener, absolute deploy ordering and receipt regression coverage were merged. This proves the publication architecture, but not freshness of the current public alias.
entries.next_quality_threshold: Produce and independently verify a fresh receipt whose snapshot timestamp, source commit, content deploy and visible scoreboards all match the current canonical snapshot.

entries.summary: A receipt-aware watchdog now checks the exact public snapshot and immutable receipt, no-ops when healthy, and dispatches the sole canonical publisher only when stale. It never deploys to Netlify directly, so recovery gains do not weaken the no-false-LIVE boundary.
entries.next_quality_threshold: Prove one watchdog-triggered recovery with a matching public timestamp, source commit, content deploy, receipt and visible scoreboards.

entries.summary: The operating system can now apply source-linked evidence automatically and refuse unsupported percentage growth as part of required validation.
entries.next_quality_threshold: Automate provider, live, business-outcome and context-efficiency evidence collection.

entries.summary: The system gained a deterministic anti-false-success boundary: stale, incomplete or older publication receipts cannot reinterpret an immutable snapshot as LIVE.
entries.next_quality_threshold: Ingest provider, live and observed business evidence automatically while preserving source-level ceilings and no-false-LIVE rules.

entries.summary: Evidence quality improved because source-type proof is now validated before scoring: merged PRs require merge proof, live claims require exact timestamp, source, receipt and visible-surface equality, and observed outcomes require a named metric with a bounded measurement window.
entries.next_quality_threshold: Feed real provider, public-live and observed-outcome records through the proof gates and measure false-positive rejection.

entries.summary: Execution resilience improved through a deterministic recovery loop that detects stale publication evidence and re-dispatches the canonical path without converting retry activity into success evidence.
entries.next_quality_threshold: Measure successful recovery rate, retry cost and time-to-proof from durable source observations.

entries.summary: Portfolio visibility and operating efficiency improved because source observations are now durable, normalized by ID, validated in Strategic Goal publication and mandatory in Agent Harness Validators. Business KPI and context/retry counters remain absent and are not credited.
entries.next_quality_threshold: Add stable provider, public-live, commercial-outcome and context/retry collectors with explicit owners and cadences.
